title: Low-Income Housing Bonds Rejected
summary:
*   The special meeting convened to officially tally and declare the results of a recent municipal election.
*   Voters rejected Proposition 1, a $7.5 million bond initiative for acquiring real estate and developing infrastructure to support low-income housing.
*   Proposition 2, a $15 million bond proposal for constructing, renovating, and repairing dwelling accommodations for low-income persons, also failed to pass.
*   Both tax-supported general obligation bond measures, totaling $22.5 million and aimed at bolstering low-income housing efforts, were ultimately voted down.
